nom: Clinique All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: This is a great eye cream. Moisturizing but not greasy or heavy. I like the smaller size for traveling. Also, BOGO free was a very good deal.

I've been using this for a few years now and loved how thick it is, locking in moisture around my eyes. But my most recent purchase seems to be slightly changed. The formula isn't as thick or "rich" anymore, it seems watered down. Feels like I'm paying for more water now and have to use more product to get the same effect.
I have been using this brand of eye cream for years. I just switched to the rich eye cream and can defiantly tell the difference in the skin around my eyes.

avis.titre: Not same as I originally purchased
avis.texte: This is a little different in texture than my first one which I like more. This isn't bad ,I feel its just a preference thing . Also don't like that there is no way of really knowing which is which being doesn't say.

My first purchase of this product I fell in love! It was the gel/cream version and on the very first application it worked within an hour. Then after a several hours the puffiness was a noticeable difference. After a week they were about 70% gone. I could use it every other day and get these results. All gel combo products have been a game changer for me regardless of the brand so to lose this eye product that worked so well is a true bummer. These other two versions don't have half the results after several weeks. I have given 4 stars for several reason: The gel version is no longer available...Grrrrrr! I didn't know this and when I ordered a new jar it took 15 minutes to figure out whether I was mistaken about my first choice, what current versions were which because there is no defining information on either jar. They both say the exact thing so I only had the color difference and texture to compare searching for the gel version– which was pointless. I'm dumbfounded a top company as this would be so careless to leave off important information. I might still buy this product if I don't find something better in the meantime.
I buy this because have not found one better although it does nothing for puffiness

I have been using All About Eyes for years. I recently placed another order and this time I accidentally ordered the Rich version of All About Eyes. Where have you been all my life! I loved it! It is so much richer (yes, the name makes senses!) and substantial than the regular All About Eyes. I'm in my early 60's and this version just makes so much more sense. I'm grateful for the happy accident!
It smooths the fine lines and gives moisturizes well the skin around eyes. Recommend

Let me start by saying I've used Clinique products since the 70's. This is the first time I had an allergic reaction to any if their products. It was burning really bad and I had to wash it off twice and put Aquaphor on my face to get it to stop. It gave me a headache. I like the first formula a lot. Returning this one. Be careful, test it first!
Love this eye cream. Great for sensitive skin. Helps with puffiness and fine lines around the eyes. Leave skin feeling soft and moisturized z

I forst tried this product when I got it as a sample. Ive always had dark circles and didn't actually think a cream would help. I liked the feel of the product so when my sample was up, I bought the large size. I ended up using this for over a year on a daily basis. While I did notice my eyes looked better, I kept forgetting to get a new jar and I ended up running out and not using this for several months. This is when I realized how well the product works. My dark circles are much more noticeable now and I look tired all the time. I'm making it a point to never run out of this again! This eye cream really does work. Yes, it's a bit pricey, but it's so worth it!
I've been using this for about 6 months now and haven't seen any improvement in dark circles.. However for moisturizing it's good!

avis.titre: I will buy again unless something comes along better
avis.texte: It is ok but cannot tell it does anything for puffiness. I think i like the Serum better than the "rich", but not much difference. I will buy one of those again unless something comes along better.

avis.titre: Weekly use, but does irritate my eyes
avis.texte: I like this product but I rarely use it without aquaphor to protect the corners of my eyes. I have extremely sensitive eyes and under eyes. I have to be very careful to not get this too close to my eyes or lots of irritation. But i do use this most mornings, not overnight
It's light but moisturizes the skin well and soothes the eyes!

since high school, I've had dark circles under my eyes no matter how much sleep I got. I've used this for years and it's become a staple in my skincare routine. better than the non-rich version - which seemed to do nothing on my black eyes lol this stuff works!
Will definitely irritate your eye balls but leave the skin feeling soft.
I see the difference immediately. Used when I was young tray but came back. Absorbs quickly and able to do make right away.

I've been using Clinique eye creams for many years. The last couple of purchases were for All About Eyes with Vitamin C, which I liked but felt it didn't de-puff enough. I came back to All About Eyes Rich and feel it works much better for me now, maybe because of the addition of hylauronic acid. I don't have many wrinkles for my age, I believe thanks to decades of Clinique skin care, but the few I've developed around my eyes have greatly diminished with this cream.

I've been using this for about a year and it is the best day and night eye cream. No pilling under makeup, and leaves my under eyes looking so good. I have dry combo skin, and tend to be dry around my eyes

avis.titre: Makes my Mascara Smear Under Eyes
avis.texte: I love the eye cream but no matter what mascara I use I get dark mascara smears under my eyes after a few hours. I only add it to the under eye bone area.
This is the only eye cream that I use. I have reordered several times.
I have been using Clinique for years and now I have added the eye cream and it is working great so far. I would recommend Clinique and this eye cream to anyone

avis.titre: I've been using this eye cream for several yrars!
avis.texte: Great eye cream for sensitive skin & eyes. I've been using this for years. Keeps the area under & around my eyes hydrated & smooth. I have extremely sensitive eyes & this is the only cream that doesn't bother them.

It seems to be pretty hydrating, but it lacks that cooling, hyper-hydrating sensation of some other eye creams I've tried. But, it does absorb quite well and you don't need a lot to get the job done. I just wish it had that cooling sensation.

avis.titre: I will repurchase this eye cream again
avis.texte: I have a lot of dryness but this cream has so much hydration. Life saver especially in winter time.
I love all about eyes rich Very moisturizing Excited about this sell Thank you
Really refreshes around the eye area. Improves dark circles too.
Love the texture of this eye cream. I have tried many eye creams but never used consistently because of the feel on my face. This one is one I actually use daily.

avis.titre: I love, love, love  this eye cream.
avis.texte: This is the most effective cream for the eyes. Been using it for years

My eyelids are extremely sensitive to most creams. At one point in my life, it was not unusual for me to wake up barely able to see through the puffiness after trying a new eye cream. Thanks to Clinique All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream, this is no longer the case. The cream soothes and softens, all free from puffiness and itching.

avis.titre: I don't know if I would buy this cream again.
avis.texte: This cream was recommended by the Ulta salesperson for my request for something to help the bags under my eyes. Although the cream is nice, not greasy, it has done nothing for my bags.
I had this before and I really could see a difference when I used it so I ordered it again and have had it for about a month now and nothing.. no difference, it's like a lotion that's all. I retuned.
I have re purchased these MANY times. It keeps my eyes hydrated and doesn't cause me any irritation. I've tried others and keep going back to this. I generally have dry skin and sensitive skin

avis.titre: Great item.  Use in the morning to start morning routine.
avis.texte: i love all Clinique items. I have had many compliments regarding my skin.

So i have tried numerous eye treatments over the years since ive lost almost 200lbs to get rid of or tighten my crepe like eye skin. Great quality top notch brands, but Clinque all about the eyes did the trick in 5 days. Tighter more tone under eye skin. No more excess baggage! I freaking live it. Im 51 yrs old and finally found my eye nirvana. I have used this brand on and off for 40 yrs to help my troubled skin issues and have never been disappointed. Worth its weight in gold. Thank you Clinque, life longer follower and loyal customer here.
Works well but I prefer the original - the "Rich" formula is fine, does the job, but I didn't find any real benefit over the regular formula.

Please do your research. This product contains many toxic ingredients and is not allergen friendly! If you have Celiac's, you should not use this product, as if contsins wheat. It contains coal tar dyes!! This is copied from the ingredient list: Yellow 5 (CI 19140), Mica, Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891). "What are coal tar dyes? They are a health and environmental hazard. "Coal tar is a mixture of many chemicals, derived from petroleum, Coal tar is recognized as a human carcinogen."

I love the brand. So, I thought I would give it a shot. This eye cream made the skin around my eyes puffy and red. It also made my eyes water. Odd because I have never had this reaction to any of their products before.

This version, All About Eyes RICH is great! I'm on my fourth or fifth jar. Be very careful when ordering. The Rich is great, but the version that just says All About Eyes without the "Rich" has Vitamin C in it and it burns a lot! I didn't realize it, just notice the most recent jar was a quite different texture and thought I had gotten a defective jar. The Rich is cream and really works great. The other one burns. Read the description carefully when ordering because the jars and labels look and say the same thing. Only the "Rich" is different.

Just a tip. I have been using All about Eyes - regular - for several months and am very impressed, so, because my skin is very dry I decided to try this rich formula. This also is excellent but I have found it works best at night only. It doesn't absorb quickly enough to go under concealer.

I have a skeletal underbite which exacerbates my eye bags and dark circles. I was given a sample by an employee and I saw immediate results. My under eye area was more plump and eye bags reduced in appearance. I was sold then and there.

This works excellent as a moisturizer, however, broke me out repeatedly with visible clogged pores around my eyes, cheeks, and nose. This is even with the two types of chemical exfoliators that I use. I wanted to love it because it was ultra moisturizing and visibly improved the look of fine lines, but I just can't make it work for me. Such a bummer.
This eye cream with Hyaluronic Acid does wonders for the circles under my eyes. I highly recommend using this with your skincare routine.
Very hydrating, plumps up fine lines. doesn't irritate skin. price is reasonable compared to other eye treatments. no scent. highly recommend
I have been using this eye cream for a while and I feel the hydration under my eyes. I use it before putting my makeup and my concealer looks so smooth and not cakey or creases.

I love this eye cream! It is so soothing and feels so cushiony under my eyes. I don't know how else to describe it but cushiony. It is rich and creamy but at the same time light. Like magic! The crepey skin under my eyes has tightened and puffiness diminished. It is so soothing. I even feel like my hereditary dark circles are improved.
Love to use this day and night. My skin care routine isn't compleate without this eye cream

I use a different brand of eye cream/gel at night. But my skin is too dry to go without moisturizing on makeup days. This is not too heavy or sticky, even though it says rich cream. Clinique reps have recommended the eye cream in the purple container, but got a deal on this during Ulta's beauty days that was too good to pass up.

avis.titre: I think I will buy again until I find one better.
avis.texte: I am using this eye puffiness product but it is not as effective as one you had that was something about Laser Focus eye cream. Do you have one more effective on puffiness?
This product just isn't as moisturizing as I need. I'm probably taking it back.
I use the all about eyes rich eye cream everyday under my concealer. Helps with dark circles and allows my concealer to go on smoothly.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I wake up with puffy eyes and have tried multiple high end brands to fix this problem. This is the eye cream that really does work for puffy eyes. So glad I bought it.
Skin feels good and fresh helps with dryness and lines . I use eye cream as well
The All About Eyes™ Rich Eye Cream is great! It reduces puffiness and dark circles, leaving my eyes refreshed. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I would not buy this version of this product again.
avis.texte: I mistakenly purchased the "rich" version of All About Eyes. I do not care for it at all, the other version is my "go to" and has been for 20 years.

Unlike any eye cream I have tried before, this works quickly and effectively in reducing my puffy under eye bags. I was completely surprised to find an eye cream that worked this well. In an hour (approximately) puffiness was gone, and my eyes looked and felt remarkably refreshed. Consistent use helps reduce the look of dark circles, as well. The Vitamin C eye cream is the same! Both outstanding! A keeper! Thank you from this 70 y o male.

I've tried several Clinique eye products, and for my concern about puffiness in the morning, the best I've used is Smart Clinical Repair. This product, All About Eyes Rich, is a nice moisturizer, but I did not find that it helped with puffiness.

avis.titre: Hydrating eye cream for dry undereyes
avis.texte: This is a rich eye cream that works well to nourish and hydrate the undereyes. Because of its thicker texture, I think this suits nighttime use better than daytime.

avis.auteur: THANKS FOR BURNING LIDS FOREVER CLINIQUE
avis.titre: You added ACID and RUINED THIS
avis.texte: I've been using AAER for decades. It was the only cream on the PLANET I could put on my eyelids without burning. I'd tried everything else on the MARKET, including the "sensitive eyes" ones that still BURNED LIKE CRAZY. Now (2024) You've gone and added ACID and put down that this purchase and all of my prior purchases were of this new formula. NOPE. It seems dishonest you would go back in time and change my order history over decades to say I've always been buying this burning punishment of an eye cream. WHY IN THE WORLD DID YOU CHANGE THIS TO MAKE IT LIKE EVERY OTHER EYE CREAM THAT BURNS BURNS BURNS? There are over 50 higher rated eye creams with hyaIuronic acid and you've made yourself one of those and don't stand out over the others, besides the obvious fact that I can't use your new stupid formula. You will not gain new customers for having added this, and you've lost my business forever. I'm so angry. I've been trying for weeks to find a new cream and everything burns but VASELINE. Have you ever tried putting makeup over VASELINE? WHY, CLINIQUE, WHY? (WAS a Clinique fan for years. WAS, past tense.)

I recently moved to AZ from the mid west, and have been battling extremely dry skin around my eyes living in a dryer climate. I've tried using multiple eye creams/moisturizers and nothing has helped. They only irritated my skin and made the dryness worse. I have extremely sensitive/combination/acne prone skin. I'm in my late 40's and needed something magical for nighttime, and this product did the trick. I wake up to moisturized skin around my eyes, less puffiness and fine lines. My only con is that it's too heavy for me to wear under makeup since the consistency is so thick. But, does absorb nicely once applied. I let it absorb for a few minutes, and then apply the Clinique mousturizing plus lotion on top of it for extra mousture which I've been using for years day and night, and also highly recommend. There's zero fragrance to the eye cream as well, and I dont get pimples around my eyes/irriatation from it either. Climique has been a savior for my skin. I recommend going to an Ulta store and getting a sample to see if it works for you. That's what I did before investing in the product. The sweet staff is always happy to help me and listen to my skin care needs. Total bonus!
I have been using this product for a few weeks now and my dark circles have practically disappeared!!!

avis.titre: Have used this product for years and will continue using it
avis.texte: Have used this product for several years & don't have crow's feet. I also use it on smile lines and light lines on forehead.

I have been using Clinique since my mid 20s now I'm in my early 40s. My entire skin care routine is Clinique. My favorite product is All About Eyes Rich. I have tried so many eye creams and none work like All About Eyes. I have allergies and this doesn't make my eyes itch and water also my eye makeup doesn't crease or come off. It also keeps the eye area feeling soft all day even with makeup on. I will forever be a Clinique fan.

avis.titre: I'm very happy to have tried this product. I absolutely love
avis.texte: I tried the product and I'm glad I did. I've never been so happy

Don't wear this under sunscreen. While on vacation I continued my skincare routine and applied the eye cream before putting on sunscreen. I burnt only in the areas where I applied the eye cream. Beware!

avis.titre: So amazing it had me in tears!
avis.texte: A new medication left my skin so dry. And the worst of it was surrounding both of my eyes. I've always been told that i "don't look 44" but now I was looking 55. Nothing worked and I didn't want to leave the house. But looked at all of the eye products in Ulta and decided to go back to my very first make-up brand…Clinique. When I tell you…I put on a small amount at night and woke up ASTOUNDED! My sensitive, dried out skin looked hydrated and healthy! I will use this for the rest of my life. And if Clinique can take care of the most sentitive area on my entire body…I'm going back to their whole line.

avis.titre: This is so amazing it had me in tears.
avis.texte: A new medication left my skin so dry. And the worst of it was surrounding both of my eyes. I've always been told that i "don't look 44" but now I was looking 55. Nothing worked and I didn't want to leave the house. But looked at all of the eye products in Ulta and decided to go back to my very first make-up brand…Clinique. When I tell you…I put on a small amount at night and woke up ASTOUNDED! My sensitive, dried out skin looked hydrated and healthy! I will use this for the rest of my life. And if Clinique can take care of the most sentitive area on my entire body…I'm going back to their whole line.

My skin reacts--usually poorly--to everything, and it's not pretty. When the specialist suggested Clinique All About Eyes Rich cream, I was hesitant, mostly because I was afraid of spending the money and then having a reaction. Didn't. Love it. Works!
Just purchase this eye cream going into my 2 week & I have notice that it is working slowly but surely on the dark circles under my eye.

avis.titre: Not as good as the price and brand name.
avis.texte: I have dark under-eyes and after using this I have found no change - finished the entire container. Maybe it's giving hydration but not helping with dark circles/puffiness. Not going to repurchase. but Yes did not cause any irritation/side effects.

I wanted to love this so much since I have used clinique pep start for a while and liked that one. I need something richer and more hydrating as I've noticed fine lines, more creasing with undereye makeup and my undereye area just looking tired and dull lately. I applied the cream at night expecting a smooth undereye area the next morning, but was disappointed when I noticed they were still tacky more than 8 hours later. I want my eye creams absorbing quickly and providing a smooth canvas for makeup. This did neither. Applying my concealer was a NIGHTMARE. When I went in with my beauty blender to blend my concealer under my eyes, to my horror it began actually removing spots of concealer everywhere the cream had touched. I tried everything to fix it and ended up having to wash my whole face plus my sponge and start over. After trying it one more time the next day and having the same experience which made me so late I almost missed an important appointment, I was done. No eye cream is worth that inconvenience. Im also worried about this causing milia because of how dense/heavy/tacky the cream is and how it seems to just sit on the skin. Its a massive no for me.

I've been using this eye cream, exclusively, for 3 years. The newest jar I bought (purchased in December 2022) has been irritating my skin. I wonder if they changed the formula. Hate to have to change products.

I have been dealing with some weird eye issues and they are making my eyelids and undereye swell. This is helping so much. It feels so good and you only need a little to cover the whole area. It is the best I've tried.
This is my tried and true product. I apply it twice a day. Under my makeup, and it's a part of my night time routine. It's light and feels like air.

Love this product. It surprisingly DID work on darkness under the eyes and wrinkles PLUS puffiness. I really didn't think it would help as I've tried so many products that just moisturize and don't improve anything else. Love that I can use this around entire eye area and not just under my eyes. Doesn't cause any problems with makeup application either. I have very sensitive skin and this didn't cause any irritation at all.

I have genetic dark circles/hollows, and found zero improvement. I have puffy eyelids from chronic dry eye, and I have mixed results. (these issues are also vitamin c resistant!) HOWEVER. I put this on, wait a moment, and my peach color corrector over it - beautiful! a little setting powder.. and youd never know I look exhausted. it keeps th powder from making your under eye super dry & old looking. so that is worth it to me!!
I have been using this for years, it corrects the puffiness under my eyes in the morning. I am 76 years old and have been using Clinic since I was in my 20's.

avis.titre: I really wanted to like this eye cream, but...
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this eye cream, but... Some time ago, I got a sample of All About Eyes Rich in one of my orders and thought to use it during my regimen. During the winter and being an older woman, I suffer extra dryness and wanted a little heavier cream for under the eyes and thought this would be perfect. It was evident right away that I was allergic to something in this formulation because I have never had a reaction to any Clinique eye cream before. I do not really like to write negative reviews so I let the issue go for a good while, but it is OK, Clinique, I quit using the cream at that time and since it was a sample, you do not have to refund me $$$s. I just wanted to inform you of the possibility that some people may have a reaction to this particular eye cream in case you may need to look into it further. Thank you for taking the time to read my concern.

avis.titre: My favorite eye cream for years
avis.texte: I have combination skin with dry spots, especially under my eyes and this cream is the only thing I used that keeps my skin hydrated without breaking me out. I've been using this for years and don't plan on changing it. Works beautifully under makeup as well. I introduced it to my mother who is in her mid-60s and she loves it too. She said it reduced her undereye circles and puffs! Highly recommend!!
I was having issues with watery eyes from retinol products and this made all the difference.

I usually purchase the regular All About Eyes, but thought I'd give this a try during the dry winter months. When I put it on in the morning before makeup, I've noticed it causes more issues with creasing, and my makeup under my eyes doesn't sit quite right, due to how thick this is. I would use this at night, and the regular All About Eyes cream during the day.
My eyelids were dry & this product is making my eyelids smooth.
I got this product as a sample and I used it one day when I didn't get much sleep and my eyes were dark. I could see the difference in under an hour or so. Since then I started using this daily.

Love this cream. Have used for years. It helps the dry under eye area and puffiness. I still use concealer for my dark circles- but these are due to genetics, aging and environmental allergies. P.S. I have used Clinique since my early 20s. So happy the product line & colors expanded to address the changes in every decade of my life!
I got both, the all about eyes and the all about eyes rich acouple of months ago. I prefer the all about eyes because it absorb quickly. Both of them work fine in my opinion.

avis.titre: Good absorption but not much else
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a month now, and I love how it doesn't leave any kind of sticky feeling or greasiness behind after application (I use morning and night). I have seen a small improvement in the dark circles under my eyes, but nothing significant.

This eye cream relieves puffiness like no other! I have always awakened to puffy eyes, and most eye creams I've used that claim to help don't make much of a difference. So I bought this product on sale and without very high expectations. However, I was amazed!!! I put this eye cream on, finish the rest of my skincare routine, and by the time I'm done all of the puffiness is gone!!! I'm hooked! It also moisturizer s very well.
Applied this product as directed and it did absolutely nothing for my lower eye lids. Would not recommend it.
This is a great eye cream and it has really brightened up my eyes. Love it!
I started having issues with my eyes a couple of years ago, having a break out and painful. My eye lids would dry out. I started using this product and it has worked ever since.

avis.titre: Comforting and safe for my auto-immune diseased eyes
avis.texte: I have several auto immune diseases and have extremely sensitive eyes. Clinique is one of the only brands I can use without a reaction. This eye cream is so comforting and does everything it says it will do. I can't live without it. I also have hereditary dark circles and anemia, and this helps so well that people have stopped asking if I'm tired… because this makes me look more awake!

ive been using this about 6 weeks. I have severe, usually 2 noticeable puffs per eye, along with darkness caused by seasonal allergies. Ive tried many products claiming to take care of both problems. This cream is better than what I've tried but still not what I want. The darkness is better, the tones are more even. My puffs are better but still a problem. which could still be the allergies. The texture of the skin is calmer. The product lasts a long time. There is more volume as well, which makes the puffs stand out more. Overall, its a good option for brand quality, cost, and duration of product.

Truth is, this kinda works for dark circles, but then again, I have yet to try anything that really does. I also have dry skin, and this really keeps my under eye skin moisturized. I can also say this does help with puffiness too. Would recommend if you're not looking for something for dark circles.

I can't use retinol eye creams so have been looking for an alternative. This eye cream works really well. I use it morning and night. It's very moisturizing without feeling greasy or sticky. It does depuff and I've seen a noticeable reduction in fine lines. No irritation, redness, burning or stinging. Will purchase again.

avis.titre: The ONLY eye cream that worked
avis.texte: When I had a death in the family and had big, pfft circles under my eyes that were red, swollen, and flaking for weeks. The saleswoman at Ulta helped me select this eye cream, and I've even been using it on the corners of my mouth, where my extremely chapped lips are cracked and split, too. This stuff is amazing. I wouldn't recommend using it on other parts of your face like I am if you're prone to acne, because it is super rich and will cause little whiteheads the next day, but if you're in desperate need of moisture, look no further! This is the fix for dryness!
Perfect for daytime use. Keeps my eye area moisturized throughout the day. Its not too heavy, just right.
I have very sensitive skin around my eyes. I bought the "rich " cream. It felt nice and went on easily. Unfortunately, this cream irritated my eyelids and won't work for me.

the most moisturizing eye cream I've tried! my under eyes get insanely dry from using trentinoin and this is the only cream I've found that actually helps with the dryness. it has a thicker texture that keeps the under eyes plump and smooth, my favorite eye cream

I get peels that go up slightly to my under eye area- to get rid of some sun damage in the area where sunblock usually meets the under eye concealer. This is a great value and quality of moisturizing compared to other more expensive brands. BUT also - This was the only under eye cream that doesn't burn terribly when my skin is peeling. Please never discontinue!

I've been using All About Eyes for several years, and really like it. As I've gotten older, I thought I'd try the "Rich" formula. It turns out I like the All About Eyes Rich even better. I use the Repairware Laser Focus for eyes at night, and use this Rich formula in the morning. I have very sensitive skin which is prone to allergic reactions, and have never had any problems with any of these products, a feature which is a requirement for me. I'm 53 now, and I have no crinkle-lines around my eyes, no crepe skin, and no dark circles underneath—so far, so good! Definitely plan on continuing to use.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use it at night. Feels great and softens the lines I'm starting to get.

I'm very careful not to put the eye cream too close to my eyes so the first time I used the cream my eyes burned in the afternoon. Today I tried it again and the burning was severe I washed out my eyes.
I use this cream every mooring without fail. I love it and nothing anyone says will ever change my mind.
It's only been a week and so far no improvement. Hope it eventually works.
I noticed a difference in the puffiness under my eye within 2days, will continue with this product.
this is the only eye cream i'll ever use, i love it so much. it's so creamy and hydrating and it helps with fine lines and wrinkles and it helps with the hard circles under my eyes
i have extremely dry under-eyes and THIS is the ONLY cream that moisturizes them. my dark circles are hereditary so there's not much there but moisture wise, this is it

I'm on my second bottle of this eye cream and while I can't say it's lightened my dark circles much, it has definitely fixed the dry, flaky under eye. Happy with this product and will most likely purchase again.

I have always had issues with dark circles under my eyes - it's hereditary. But I have been using this stuff religiously and while I cannot say this is a miracle and completely removed my dark circles, it has made a significant difference! I can now use a little lighter under my eyes without still looking like a raccoon or looking cakey trying to cover the dark circles up.

I used to have really dark eye bags and was super self conscious about it so was willing to spend the money to try this and I do not regret the decision! I use this daily and have seen massive improvement! I bought some for my mother as well, as she is a night nurse and constantly masking + sleep deprivation has taken a toll on her eyes. I can SEE the improvement this product has made!
